source_refs.note: i) Catalytic convertor (CC): a main subheading of 14.14 Strategies used to reduce air pollution, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 317-317.

blocks.text: Gariyon ke engines nitrogen ke oxides, CO aur bina jale hydrocarbons jaisi harmful gases chhorte hain. Zyada tar cars mein catalytic converter laga hota hai jo in harmful pollutants ko harmless (nuqsan na dene wali) cheezon mein badal deta hai: CO oxidise ho kar CO₂ banti hai; NOₓ reduce ho kar N₂ banti hain; aur bina jale hydrocarbons CO₂ aur H₂O mein badal jate hain.
